verdict.rationale: Inngest documents step.ai.wrap(), which wraps the OpenAI, Anthropic, and Vercel AI SDKs as durable steps. It also ships its own agent framework, AgentKit, and documents durable agents whose every step and tool call is checkpointed. However, the evidence shows no first-party wrappers for third-party agent frameworks, and the coverage of model providers is limited to the named SDKs. missing for 10: integrations with third-party agent frameworks (e.g. wrapping external agent libraries), a broader catalog of model-provider integrations, independent hands-on corroboration that no glue code is needed.

support.subject: As an agent builder, first-party integrations wrap my AI stack — AI SDKs, agent frameworks, model providers — so agent steps get durability without glue code

citations.quote: step.ai.wrap() wraps other AI SDKs (OpenAI, Anthropic, and Vercel AI SDK) as a step
AgentKit is a framework to build AI Agents, from single model inference calls to multi-agent systems that use tools.
Every step, every tool call, every decision the agent makes is checkpointed as it happens.
